text: かんたん　には　あわせ　ないぜ！

structure.en: I won't let you meet her!

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: Changing あう to あわせる turns 'meet' into 'let someone meet', and ない makes it 'not'. あわせ　ない = 'I won't let you meet her'.

patterns.name: 〜には
patterns.explanation: は added to かんたんに, with a 'not' after it, gives the feel of 'not that easily, anyway'. かんたん　には　あわせ　ない = 'I won't let you meet her that easily'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, manly speech that pushes what was said. あわせ　ないぜ = 'I won't let you meet her, got it!'.
